messages:
Maia (PM): sharing new frames for the onboarding checkflow: https://www.figma.com/file/mnop3456/onboard-checkflow
Maia (PM): core question: mini-rail (compact chip that expands) vs banner (full-width) for first-run quickstarts. want to minimize friction but not hide value. need copy + accessibility signoff.

Eli (Designer): mini-rail is unobtrusive and fits desktop apps nicely; banner is clearer for users who skip. rail can surface a small sample picker on expand.

Hana (UX): metric goals: improve sample activation by 20% without increasing "dismiss" complaints. propose short qualitative intercept on variant exposure.

Theo (Frontend): dev notes: rail requires click-to-expand tray with focus management; banner needs sticky behavior and responsive collapse. both need persisted per-workspace state.

Lina (A11y): a11y checklist quick: contrast for small label text, aria-expanded on rail button, role=dialog for tray with focus trap and return (but only trap while open), skip link to main content, announce via aria-live when content loads.

Rohit (Devex): tracking: event names onboard_shown, onboard_opened, onboard_sample_launched, onboard_skipped. we'll include variant param and experiment_id.

Eli (Designer): copy candidates: 
- Friendly: "Try a sample project — 5 min" CTA: "Open sample" Secondary: "Later"
- Direct: "Start with a sample" CTA: "Use sample" Secondary: "Skip"
Which tone for first-run?

Maia (PM): prefer Friendly first, Direct for a later follow-up nudge. keep microcopy that states what the sample showcases (chat / embeddings).

Hana (UX): add small trust note: "No data sent" or "Private to your workspace" when sample uses keys / telemetry. reduces privacy friction.

Lina (A11y): also: don't rely on color alone to convey "5 min" tag; include screen-reader text like "approximately five minutes to complete".

Theo (Frontend): CSS idea for rail expand:
```css
.onboard-rail { position: fixed; right: 20px; bottom: 28px; }
.onboard-tray[aria-expanded=\"true\"] { transform: scaleY(1); }
```
I'll ensure close button gets focus first when tabbing.

Rohit (Devex): feature flag plan: rollout to 10% external with split variants (rail|banner). metric gates: activation uplift + dismiss rate < 8%.

ops-bot: reminder 0 run axe smoke and keyboard-nav CI on PRs.

Maia (PM): action items: Eli update frames + include friendly/direct copy; Lina to review tokens and SR text; Theo to open draft PR with DOM order + focus management; Rohit add events + flag. target: Thu EOD for PRs and internal canary next Tue.

Eli (Designer): will post updated prototypes with contrast numbers and mobile behavior tomorrow.

Lina (A11y): will do code review once PRs posted and run a quick NVDA check.

Maia (PM): perfect, thanks all. will schedule qualitative intercept during canary. ping here if blocked.
